messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: paging rule 'inference.high_latency.v2' fired 213 times in the last 5m for prod-us-east. Severity: P1. Paginated to on-call. See: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/INV-1842 :rotating_light:
Priya K: on it. I see tail lat spikes from model-quant2 on pool-gpu-3. Starting mitigation: rerouting 25% of traffic to fallback model (quant1) and scaling pool-gpu-3 by +2 nodes.
Priya K: @Lina can you check recent deploys to model-serving? Any config changes?
Lina G: no deploys to model-serving in the last 30m. I see a growth in avg seq len for a subset of requests from a single customer integration (id: cust-42). Pulling logs now.
Marco S: capturing timeline. Also I'm going to temporarily raise the alert squelch to avoid duplicate pages while we triage. Will propose tuning after RCA.
Sanjay R: customer impact: PRD metrics show 0.6% 99th latency increase for text generation customers; cust-42 accounts for ~12% of requests to that shard. Might be a bad prompt pattern.
Aisha T: heads-up from product, cust-42 has active campaign now — they will probably be sensitive. Please call if I should loop CS.
Priya K: quick mitigation completed: reroute + autoscale done. Latency trending down but still noisy.
Priya K: forwarding logs snippet to thread:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z model=quant2 pool=gpu-3 req_id=... seq_len=4096 latency=1.2s
2026-03-15T10:12:07Z model=quant2 pool=gpu-3 req_id=... seq_len=4120 latency=1.5s
```
Lina G: looks like KV cache misses spiked for sequences >4k. Might need longer cache TTL or disabled per-request cache bypass. I'll open an issue.
Marco S: action: silence paging for 'inference.high_latency.v2' for next 15m with annotation "investigating KV cache misses; reroute in place" so SOC isn't flooded.
deploy-bot: deploy 1829 to routing-service started by Priya K — rolling canary for routing rule to reduce quant2 weight to 50%. (deploy link: https://ci.redwood.internal/1829)
Priya K: please add a dashboard panel for "KV-cache miss rate by model" — I can't debug it easily in existing dashboard.
Marco S: will add a grafana panel and a short-runbook note. Proposing the following alert tuning after the incident:
```yaml
- name: inference.high_latency.v2
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.9
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: p2 # lower from p1 for non-bursty patterns
  annotations:
    runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.internal/inference/high-latency
```
Marco S: key point: add a label 'source_shard' and break down by customer; plus add a static squelch window for post-deploy noisy windows.
Priya K: @Marco please add an explicit note in the runbook about KV cache miss troubleshooting steps and include the exact k8s pod labels to inspect. Also add contact for Lina for model runtime.
Marco S: will update runbook and raise a PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/pulls/67
Lina G: I've opened infra issue for cache TTL review: INFRA-559. Adding steps to instrument per-request cache hit metrics.
Sanjay R: recommendation: temporarily tag alerts from that shard as 'customer-impact: cust-42' in monitoring so paging routing sends to product owner + oncall for now.
Priya K: agreed — tagging done for current incidents. But we should avoid permanent customer-specific paging. Use for escalation only.
Aisha T: product wants a proactive message to cust-42 if we anticipate degraded UX for >15m. Assigning @Sanjay to coordinate comms if it persists.
Priya K: ownership + next steps: 
- Marco S: update alert rule, add 'source_shard' dimension, adjust severity -> PR #67 (owner)
- Lina G: infra ticket INFRA-559 + add cache metrics (owner)
- Priya K: follow up on routing PR and monitor for 1h, update thread when stable (owner)
- Sanjay R: stand by for customer comms if degradation continues >15m (owner)
Marco S: I've added an annotated dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/kv-cache-metrics (panel id: 12). Also added alert tag docs at https://monitoring.redwood.internal/docs/alert-tagging
Priya K: updated runbook link in annotations to the new PR once merged.
deploy-bot: deploy 1829 to routing-service succeeded — canaries passed.
Priya K: latency back to baseline. Confirming no further pagings for 30m.
Marco S: postmortem plan: short incident writeup + alert tuning RFC. I'll own the RFC and tag SRE/Runtime. Target to close changes in 3 business days.
Lina G: will include cache instrumentation work in the runtime sprint and link PRs in postmortem.
Sanjay R: leaving a note: when adding 'source_shard' dimension, ensure cardinality limited (top-10 shards only) to avoid high-cardinality costs.
Priya K: thanks all. I'll add final notes to the runbook and mark this thread resolved once PR #67 merges. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INV-1842 status changed -> RESOLVED by Priya K. Duration: 42m.
